name: leverage_ratio_ccf_exposure_shortfall_pair
question_template: Apply only this fictional scenario-local leverage rule. Gross Tier 1 capital before deductions is {GROSS_T1} USD million. Goodwill of {GOODWILL} USD million is deducted in full. Deferred tax assets of {DTA} USD million are deducted in full (the entire DTA amount, not just the excess) if they are above {DTA_THRESH_PCT} percent of gross Tier 1 capital; if not above that threshold, no DTA deduction applies. On-balance-sheet assets of {ON_BS} USD million enter the exposure measure in full; undrawn commitments of {UNDRAWN} USD million enter at {CCF_PCT} percent of notional. The exposure measure is their sum. The leverage ratio in percent is Tier 1 capital after deductions divided by the exposure measure, times 100. The minimum ratio is {MIN_PCT} percent. The capital shortfall is the additional Tier 1 capital in USD million that brings the ratio exactly to the minimum with the exposure measure unchanged; if the ratio already meets or exceeds the minimum, the shortfall is 0. If Tier 1 capital after deductions is zero or negative the case is invalid. Keep all values exact. Report Tier 1 capital after deductions, the exposure measure, the leverage ratio in percent, and finally the capital shortfall.

slots.description: Tier 1 capital after goodwill and excess deferred tax asset deductions, USD million
On-balance-sheet assets plus credit-converted undrawn commitments, USD million
Tier 1 after deductions relative to exposure measure, in percentage points

program:
def solve():
    gross_t1 = Q(P["GROSS_T1"])
    goodwill = Q(P["GOODWILL"])
    dta = Q(P["DTA"])
    thresh_pct = Q(P["DTA_THRESH_PCT"])
    on_bs = Q(P["ON_BS"])
    undrawn = Q(P["UNDRAWN"])
    ccf_pct = Q(P["CCF_PCT"])
    min_pct = Q(P["MIN_PCT"])

    dta_threshold = gross_t1 * thresh_pct / Q(100)
    if dta > dta_threshold:
        dta_deduction = dta
    else:
        dta_deduction = Q(0)
    tier1_after = gross_t1 - goodwill - dta_deduction
    if tier1_after <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Tier 1 capital after deductions is not positive")

    exposure = on_bs + undrawn * ccf_pct / Q(100)
    leverage_pct = tier1_after / exposure * Q(100)

    required_t1 = exposure * min_pct / Q(100)
    shortfall = required_t1 - tier1_after
    if shortfall < 0:
        shortfall = Q(0)

    return {
        "final": shortfall,
        "tier1_after_deductions": tier1_after,
        "exposure_measure": exposure,
        "leverage_ratio_percent": leverage_pct,
    }
